title: Make frontier pressure capability-aware without changing claim authority
mission: Extend the allocator/metabolism projection so FRONTIER_THIN/LOW_YIELD evidence distinguishes total clean frontier from candidates compatible with generic repository-capable /wc workers versus specialized browser/mobile/host/dispatch capability buckets. Derive this only from already-compiled required_capabilities; add no preclaim reads, do not suppress specialized work, do not weaken deterministic POOL sharding, and do not manufacture filler jobs.
definition_of_done: Allocator/live evidence publishes total clean frontier plus a generic-compatible count and bounded specialized capability buckets derived from candidate.required_capabilities.
Generic-compatible classification is deterministic from allocator metadata and treats unknown capability as unknown rather than absent.
A fixture matching the 2026-09-18 PROD-01 shape proves browser/mobile/host/dispatch-only candidates do not inflate the generic-compatible count.
Guide planner/rescate evidence can cite the capability-aware pressure signal without requiring disposable workers to read extra preclaim context.
Existing claim authority, three-attempt bound, capability filtering and POOL sharding semantics remain unchanged.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion occurs.
